description: This file defines a Flutter widget class `AccountPage` representing a user account screen with a greeting, profile icon, and a list of options such as Orders, Settings, and Help & Support. It also includes a private `_Tile` widget used for list items.

classes.name: AccountPage
classes.description: A stateless widget displaying user account information and navigational options.

classes.name: _Tile
classes.description: A private stateless widget representing an individual option row with icon, label, and chevron.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for `AccountPage` and `_Tile` widgets.
